name: Bingles' Missing Supplies
summary: On Loch Modan’s southeastern shore, Bingles Blastenheimer is stranded after troggs steal his gear. You can recover his tools and Blastencapper explosives so he can repair his gyrocopter and return to the fight for Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Damp Descent
sections.body: Bingles Blastenheimer crashes his gyrocopter into Loch Modan’s cold waters. He drags himself ashore, dazed, and troggs from the lake’s central islands swarm him. They steal his most valuable belongings.

sections.title: Gnomish Ingenuity Under Siege
sections.body: Troggs scatter Bingles’ gear among their island camps. The stolen things include a wrench, screwdriver, and hammer, along with his volatile, high-yield invention, the Blastenheimer Blastencapper. Left among troggs, the explosives put travelers in immediate danger.

sections.title: For Gnomeregan
sections.body: Bingles fights to free Gnomeregan, his homeland, from subterranean troggs and irradiated leper gnomes. He imagines a decisive aerial assault, but without his tools and Blastencappers he cannot rebuild his flying machine. His campaign remains grounded in the reeds.

faq.q: Why is Bingles Blastenheimer stranded in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Bingles Blastenheimer is stranded in Loch Modan after crashing his gyrocopter. He struggles ashore on the southeastern bank, where troggs from nearby islands ambush him and steal his tools and experimental explosives.

faq.q: What supplies were stolen by the troggs?
faq.answer: The troggs steal Bingles’ wrench, screwdriver, hammer, and specialized explosive, the Blastenheimer Blastencapper.

faq.q: Where did the troggs take Bingles' gear?
faq.answer: The troggs take Bingles’ gear to their camps on islands in the northern part of the Loch. They scatter the tools and explosives along the rocky shores.
The Blastenheimer Blastencapper is an explosive device Bingles designed for air strikes against the enemies occupying Gnomeregan.

faq.q: What movement is Bingles referring to?
faq.answer: Bingles refers to reclaiming Gnomeregan. He hopes to lead an aerial bombardment against the subterranean troggs and leper gnomes holding the gnomish capital.

faq.q: Why can't Bingles retrieve the supplies himself?
faq.answer: Bingles cannot retrieve the supplies because he is alone and unarmed after the crash, and his gyrocopter is out of reach. Crossing open water to face aggressive troggs without weapons or aircraft would be suicide for a lone engineer.

angles.text: As a gnome, each tool you recover brings your people closer to an aerial counteroffensive against the troggs and leper gnomes suffocating Gnomeregan.
As a dwarf, you know the troggs on the Loch’s islands threaten local trade and travel. Any blow against their camps helps the Mountaineers.
As an engineer, you know specialized tools and volatile explosives like the Blastenheimer Blastencapper are dangerous in trogg hands and an affront to craftsmanship.
As an Alliance member, helping a fellow pilot in Loch Modan secures the waterways and aids the wider effort to reclaim Khaz Modan’s lost territories.
